summary.text: Sue Peterson is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 13 who assumed office in January 2025 after serving in the state House from 2017 to 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A banker by profession, she holds a bachelor's degree from Concordia University and a graduate degree from the University of South Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Sue Peterson earned a bachelor's degree from Concordia University and a graduate degree from the University of South Dakota, and her career experience includes working as a banker.
Peterson represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 13 from 2017 to 2025 before assuming office in the State Senate on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the Senate Commerce and Energy Committee, where she is vice chair, and to the Senate Education Committee and the Senate State Affairs Committee.
